name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 16, 2016 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Olivenhain Boy Scout Troop 2000 led by Senior Patrol Leader Michael Sturman, Rank of Life Scout, an Olivenhain Boy Scout and 9th grader at San Dieguito Academy
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation to Ken Harrison, Olivenhain Boy Scout Troop 2000 departing Assistant Scout Master
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 24, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-03-16 Item 8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-03-16 Item 8B Warrants
8C.
The preparation and filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Reuss
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-21, directing the preparation and filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District annual report.
2016-03-16 Item 8C Encinitas Landscaping and Lighting
8D.
City of Encinitas participation in the 2016 National Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-32 supporting the City of Encinitas' participation in the 2016 National Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation.
2016-03-16 Item 8D Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation
8E.
Council Resolution No. 2016-31 supporting seed saving within the City of Encinitas and requesting city staff to support changes in State seed law to allow seed-sharing without cost or germination testing. Contact Person: Council Member Blakespear
That Council adopt Resolution 2016-31, titled "Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas supporting seed saving within the City of Encinitas and requesting city staff to support changes in State seed law to allow seed-sharing without cost or germination testing."
2016-03-16 Item 8E Seed Bill
8F.
Assignment of Coffee Cart License Agreement at the Encinitas Library. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That Council gives the City Manager authority to exercise the assignment clause in the coffee cart licensing agreement at the Encinitas Library.
2016-03-16 Item 8F Coffee Cart License
8G.
Leo Mullen Sports Park Turf Replacement Project (CP16B) Coastal Development Permit Processing. Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
Receive the staff report and determine if the current Coastal Development Permit application should be modified to eliminate sports field lighting footings.
2016-03-16 Item 8G Leo Mullen CDP
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit to allow a second-story addition to a dwelling unit within a 50% interest subdivision. The project site is located within the Residential 11 (R-11) Zone and the Coastal Zone in the community of Old Encinitas. CASE NUMBER: 15-247 DR/CDP; APPLICANT: Derek Bradley/Gina Merchant; APPELLANT:
Friends to Preserve Encinitas Beauty; LOCATION: 269 Rosebay Drive (APN: 257-080-20-01). Contact Person: Associate Planner Maynard
Deny the appeal and adopt the Draft Resolution No. 2016-26 affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit application, thus allowing a second-story addition to a dwelling unit within a 50% interest subdivision for the reasons outlined below, under the analysis section of this report and previous Planning Commission report. Alternative options are also provided in the analysis section.
2016-03-16 Item 10A DRCDP Appeal - 269 Rosebay_Part1
2016-03-16 Item 10A DRCDP Appeal - 269 Rosebay_Part2
2016-03-16 Item 10A Additional Information
10B.
Public Hearing to consider funding recommendations for eligible activities under the FY2016-17 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Authorize funding for activities delineated in Attachment 1 and the Analysis Section of the Agenda Report for incorporation in the the draft FY2016-17 Annual Action Plan; and 2) Continue the public hearing to April 20, 2016 to gather public input prior to Council's approval of the FY2016-17 CDBG budget and the FY 2016-17 Annual Action Plan.
2016-03-16 Item 10B Community Development Block Grant Program
10C.
Encinitas Environmental Education (E3) Cluster Traffic Calming Concept Plan for Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Blough
Staff recommends that minor striping modifications be completed on the northern portion of Saxony Road and at the entrance to the San Diego Botanic Garden's left turn pocket in the first phase. However, due to the potential traffic diversion impacts that other features of this concept plan may have on other roadways, staff is recommending that the Council study these concepts as an alternative in the upcoming Roadway Master Plan and Circulation Element Update.
2016-03-16 Item 10C E3 Cluster Presentation Traffic Calming
10D.
Street Lighting Conversion Project. Contact Person: Sr. Mgt. Analyst Ruess ***THIS ITEM HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE AGENDA BY STAFF***
1) Direct staff to work with San Diego Gas and Electric (SDG&E) to purchase the streetlights owned by SDGE; and 2) Direct staff to pursue the Street Light Conversion Project.
2016-03-16 Item 10D Streetlight Conversion Project
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2016-03-16 Item 15 City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
